g.text: Concurrent motion · independent jobs and persistent ICC buffers
Each lane's long-lived send coroutine owns one frame buffer.
A synchronous helper fills it; transport borrows its span.
Reuse waits for send completion. No full-frame coroutine
is allocated for each message or heartbeat.
Repeated overlap / stop / restart and analyzer checks pass.
The new host test forbids full-frame allocations during
heartbeat traffic after startup. This is not a maximum-rate
Motor-disconnected application fixture; physical commissioning remains separate.
Heartbeat 100 ms / deadline 500 ms and ownership lease 250 ms are unchanged.
